description: Real-time Google Flights fares. One call searches a whole date range and multiple destination airports, and each result carries Google's own price-insight verdict. Bring your own RapidAPI key.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user google-flights https://google-flights-mcp.flightpowers.com/mcp --header "x-rapidapi-key: <YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY>"

notes: The caller supplies their own RapidAPI key with the `x-rapidapi-key` header or a `rapidapi_key` query parameter; the server stores no upstream credential.
Keys, including a free tier, come from https://rapidapi.com/mtnrabi/api/google-flights-live-api

clients: MCP clients with Streamable HTTP support
